headline: Türkiye and Russia's Tatneft Inaugurate $330M Petrochemical Plant
summary: Top Turkish and Russian officials attended the inauguration of a new $330 million petrochemical facility built in Turkey's northwestern Kocaeli province.
why: Petrochemical investments bolster domestic industrial manufacturing capacity and bilateral trade ties.
